plugins.name: pt4ai
plugins.description: Precision Toolkit for AI. An operating discipline for working with a model: read the source before asserting it, verify a claim before stating it, and gates that say what they are not checking instead of reporting clean. Adds always-on rules, a precision-mode skill, write-time hooks, and pre-publish checks that keep private material out of public work.
